rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for doing something playfully or mischievously.

example.english: They impishly pretended not to know me, and I almost believed them.
example.traditional: 佢鬼馬咁扮唔識我，搞到我差啲信咗。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gwai2 maa5 gam3 baan6 m4 sik1 ngo5 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 caa1 di1 seon3 zo2

rows.note: Use this especially when describing a child or someone behaving naughtily in a playful way.

example.english: The child impishly hid my glasses under the pillow.
example.traditional: 個細路頑皮咁將我副眼鏡藏喺枕頭底。
example.jyutping: go3 sai3 lou6 waan4 pei4 gam3 zoeng1 ngo5 fu3 ngaan5 geng3 cong4 hai2 zam2 tau4 dai2

rows.note: Use this when the impish behavior involves deliberately playing a trick or causing playful trouble.

example.english: They impishly put salt in my glass of water.
example.traditional: 佢搞鬼咁喺我杯水入面加咗鹽。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gaau2 gwai2 gam3 hai2 ngo5 bui1 seoi2 jap6 min6 gaa1 zo2 jim4
